sections.overview: A Brazilian pimelodid catfish endemic to the Doce basin.
sections.identification: It is one of six recognized Steindachneridion species, a genus whose revision documents shared anatomical characters.
sections.ecology: Unlike congeners S. amblyurum (Jequitinhonha) and S. melanodermatum (Iguaçu), it is recorded from the Doce.
